title: Hot Reload
concept: Hot reload updates running code without restarting — recompile on save, reload in place. Essential for game engines, UI development, and live systems.
why: The edit-compile-run-restart cycle kills productivity. Hot reload compiles and patches running code in milliseconds — see changes instantly.
syntax_ref:
xiom hot-reload <file>        # Enable hot reloading
xiom hot-reload --no-state    # Don't preserve global state
xiom hot-reload --port 9000   # WebSocket port for editor integration
tips: Keep hot-reloadable code in separate modules — makes reload faster and safer
Global state persists across reloads — use it for counters, configs, and live data
Not all code can be hot-reloaded — static memory layouts and type definitions are fixed
Hot reload is a development tool, not a deployment strategy — use regular builds for production
common_mistakes: Changing type definitions during hot reload — requires full rebuild, not hot reload
Assuming hot reload works for all code — static functions and type layouts can't be patched
Using hot reload in production — performance overhead and stability risks
